name: Microwave Palak Tofu
steps: Place the spinach in a covered bowl and microwave on high for 3 minutes until wilted. Cool and blend to a purée.
In another bowl, microwave the oil, cumin, onion, garlic and ginger covered on high for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato and microwave for 2 minutes. Stir in the spinach purée and ¼ cup water.
Add the tofu and garam masala, cover and microwave for 3 minutes. Stir gently and stand for 2 minutes.
note: The quickest palak dish; the spinach keeps its colour because it cooks only briefly.
